description: Undo a merge: the account becomes its own person again for your organization. A merge made in a keyword group is undone with that groupId.

groupId.description: Scope to one keyword group (grp_...): only people who mentioned that group's keywords, with that group's own tags, notes, mute, merges, activities and segments. Omit for the whole workspace.

id.description: Audience author id (aut_...), from list_people or a mention's authorId
